name: MinkowskiBroadcastMultiplication
definition: Broadcasts reduced global features to all input coordinates by multiplying them element-wise with the input sparse tensor features. The output coordinates are identical to the input coordinates.
summary: MinkowskiBroadcastMultiplication broadcasts a reduced global feature vector to all active sparse tensor coordinates by multiplying it element-wise with input features, differing from addition or concatenation by modulating local features multiplicatively.
